title: The Long Stair
description: Past the landing the stair stops pretending to arrive
anywhere. It goes down the way water goes down, having
The gravel gallery below is where the hill stops being
architecture and becomes geology: scree, seep water, and
timber props holding arguments the rock has not agreed
Six stations, the same six, in grey. The theme changes
and the descent does not notice.
If the way back is ever in doubt, the answer is the same
as it always was: up the stair, out the door, left at the
greenwood, and apologise to the map room.
